verdict.rationale: Mangopay's wallet infrastructure supports platform fees (docs-10 mentions fees wired to bank account monthly, and wallet/split-transfer capabilities in docs-5, docs-11) implying application-fee/markup mechanics are technically possible, but there is no explicit documentation of per-seller custom pricing configuration or of a dashboard/report that separates platform revenue (fees/markup) from processing costs. missing for 10: explicit per-seller fee configuration docs, revenue vs. cost reporting/dashboard evidence, and independent confirmation that fee structures can be customized per seller.
